project.name: llm-gateway
project.description: A small OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway built for learning: virtual keys, usage and cost tracking, rate limits, budgets, retries, fallback, circuit breaker, metrics, caching, and a Kubernetes deployment; routes to OpenAI or Anthropic.

nodes.name: admin.py
nodes.summary: Builds the /admin FastAPI router for creating and revoking virtual keys and reading per-key usage, guarded by a constant-time admin-token check that rejects virtual keys.

nodes.name: CreateKey
nodes.summary: Pydantic request model for creating a virtual key with name, allowed models, RPM limit and monthly budget validation.

nodes.name: bearer_from
nodes.summary: Extracts the bearer token from the Authorization header, returning None for other schemes or empty tokens.

nodes.name: make_admin_router
nodes.summary: Builds the /admin APIRouter with an admin-token dependency and endpoints to create keys, read key usage and revoke keys.

nodes.name: context.py
nodes.summary: Defines the per-request RequestContext dataclass that every pipeline stage reads and writes, plus Target, Usage and the GatewayResponse returned through the stage chain.

nodes.name: Target
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass naming a provider and its concrete model ID.

nodes.name: Usage
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding input/output token counts and whether they were estimated.

nodes.name: RequestContext
nodes.summary: Mutable per-request state shared across stages: request body, alias, bearer, key, target, timing, usage, cache flags, status and error.

nodes.name: GatewayResponse
nodes.summary: Response passed back through stages carrying status, a JSON body or an async stream, and headers.

nodes.name: errors.py
nodes.summary: Declares the GatewayError hierarchy (400-504) that renders errors in the OpenAI error shape with optional Retry-After headers so existing SDKs behave correctly.

nodes.name: GatewayError
nodes.summary: Base gateway exception with HTTP status, OpenAI error type, code and retry_after, rendering an OpenAI-shaped body and Retry-After header.

nodes.name: base.py
nodes.summary: Declares the Limiter protocol: an async acquire(key_id, rpm) returning whether a request is allowed and the wait until a token is available.

nodes.name: Limiter
nodes.summary: Protocol for rate limiter backends exposing async acquire returning (allowed, retry_after_seconds).

nodes.name: pricing.py
nodes.summary: Computes request cost in USD from the per-million-token pricing table and provides a rough 4-chars-per-token estimate for streams cut short.

nodes.name: cost_usd
nodes.summary: Computes USD cost from per-million input/output token prices, rounded to 6 decimals.

nodes.name: text_of
nodes.summary: Flattens OpenAI message content (string or list of text parts) into plain text.

nodes.name: estimate_tokens
nodes.summary: Estimates prompt tokens at about 4 characters per token plus per-message overhead.

nodes.name: auth.py
nodes.summary: Authentication stage that hashes the bearer key, looks up the virtual key in the store, rejects missing/revoked keys and enforces the key's allowed model aliases.

nodes.name: authenticate
nodes.summary: Hashes the bearer key, fetches the virtual key from the store and raises Unauthorized for missing, unknown or revoked keys while recording failure metrics.

nodes.name: allowed
nodes.summary: Checks whether a virtual key may use the requested model alias.

nodes.name: Auth
nodes.summary: Pipeline stage authenticating the caller, clearing the raw bearer, enforcing model allow-lists and attaching the key to the context.

nodes.name: base.py
nodes.summary: Defines the Stage protocol and Next callable type, and build_chain which composes stages into a nested middleware chain around a terminal handler.

nodes.name: Stage
nodes.summary: Protocol for an async pipeline stage taking a RequestContext and the next handler.

nodes.name: build_chain
nodes.summary: Composes stages in reverse with functools.partial so stages[0] is outermost around the terminal handler.

nodes.name: budget.py
nodes.summary: Budget stage enforcing a soft monthly USD spend cap per virtual key by checking the store's spend before forwarding the request.

nodes.name: Budget
nodes.summary: Stage that raises BudgetExceeded when a key's month-to-date spend reaches its monthly budget.

nodes.name: rate_limit.py
nodes.summary: Rate-limit stage that acquires a per-key token from the Limiter and raises 429 RateLimited with Retry-After when the requests-per-minute bucket is empty.

nodes.name: RateLimit
nodes.summary: Stage that acquires a per-key token bucket slot and raises RateLimited with Retry-After when exhausted.

nodes.name: usage.py
nodes.summary: Usage stage that writes one usage row per authenticated request when the response (or stream) finishes, estimating tokens when needed and computing cost; writes are shielded and never raise.

nodes.name: UsageStage
nodes.summary: Stage that records a UsageRow after non-streaming responses, errors, or stream completion/cancellation, estimating tokens and computing cost.

nodes.name: base.py
nodes.summary: Defines the Store protocol for virtual-key and usage persistence, the VirtualKey and UsageRow dataclasses, and UTC timestamp/month-start helpers.

nodes.name: VirtualKey
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass describing a virtual API key with model allow-list, RPM limit, monthly budget and revocation timestamp.

nodes.name: UsageRow
nodes.summary: Dataclass for one persisted usage record: tokens, cost, latency, TTFT, status and cache hit.

nodes.name: Store
nodes.summary: Protocol defining async persistence operations for keys and usage, plus a health ping.

nodes.name: utc_ts
nodes.summary: Formats a UTC datetime in a fixed ISO format so string comparison sorts by time.

nodes.name: month_start
nodes.summary: Returns the start of the current UTC month for spend calculations.

nodes.name: sqlite.py
nodes.summary: aiosqlite-backed implementation of the Store protocol managing api_keys and usage tables: key creation with hashed secrets, revocation, usage recording, monthly spend and usage summaries.

nodes.name: hash_key
nodes.summary: SHA-256 hashes a plaintext virtual key for storage and lookup.

nodes.name: _key
nodes.summary: Converts a SQLite row into a VirtualKey, decoding the JSON allowed_models list.

nodes.name: SqliteStore
nodes.summary: SQLite Store implementation over a single aiosqlite connection that applies the schema and implements key CRUD, usage recording, spend and summaries.

nodes.name: test_stages.py
nodes.summary: Pytest suite exercising pipeline stages in isolation with fake call_next and FakeStore: chain ordering, auth, revocation, rate limiting, budget, and cache key/TTL/LRU/eligibility behavior.

nodes.name: make_ctx
nodes.summary: Test helper building a RequestContext from a ChatRequest with defaults.

nodes.name: vkey
nodes.summary: Test helper constructing a VirtualKey with overridable defaults.

nodes.name: ok
nodes.summary: Fake terminal handler returning a simple successful GatewayResponse.

nodes.name: FakeStore
nodes.summary: In-memory fake Store returning a configured key for 'gw-good' and a fixed monthly spend.

nodes.name: test_build_chain_order
nodes.summary: Verifies build_chain runs stages outermost-first and unwinds in reverse order.

nodes.name: test_auth
nodes.summary: Tests Auth stage handling of missing, invalid, forbidden-model and valid keys.

nodes.name: test_revoked_key_is_unauthorized
nodes.summary: Checks that a revoked key is rejected as Unauthorized.

nodes.name: test_rate_limit_stage
nodes.summary: Tests RateLimit stage raising RateLimited with Retry-After once the bucket is empty.

nodes.name: test_budget_stage
nodes.summary: Tests Budget stage raising BudgetExceeded when spend reaches the cap.

nodes.name: test_cache_key_ignores_stream_and_user
nodes.summary: Verifies cache_key ignores stream and user fields but is scoped per key.

nodes.name: test_cache_ttl_and_lru
nodes.summary: Tests cache TTL expiry and LRU eviction using a FakeClock.

nodes.name: test_cache_skips_streams_and_nonzero_temperature
nodes.summary: Checks the cache only serves non-streaming temperature-0 requests and honors bypass.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker that makes `gateway` an importable Python package; modules import siblings like metrics and tracing through it.

nodes.name: app.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI application factory that wires providers, circuit breakers, the SQLite store and the stage pipeline (Observe, Auth, Usage, RateLimit, Budget, Cache, Route), and exposes the chat completions, models, health, readiness, metrics and drain endpoints.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an asynccontextmanager lifespan for startup/shutdown and nested route closures over a Deps dataclass instead of FastAPI dependency injection.

nodes.name: metrics.py
nodes.summary: Defines every Prometheus counter, histogram and gauge the gateway emits (requests, latency, TTFT, tokens, cost, rejections, cache, upstream attempts, breaker state) using bounded label sets.

nodes.name: breaker.py
nodes.summary: Per-provider circuit breaker implementing closed/open/half-open transitions with a single half-open trial slot, reporting state to a Prometheus gauge.

nodes.name: retry.py
nodes.summary: Upstream attempt loop handling first-byte timeouts, jittered exponential backoff retries, target rotation for fallback, and breaker bookkeeping for both streaming and non-streaming calls.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses asyncio.timeout with a shared deadline and treats BaseException (cancellation) as a neutral outcome that releases the breaker trial slot.

nodes.name: Deps
nodes.summary: Dataclass bundling config, settings, store, providers, breakers, limiter and draining flag shared by the app's routes and admin router.

nodes.name: request_id_from
nodes.summary: Returns the incoming x-request-id header if it is safe, otherwise generates a random request ID.

nodes.name: SSEResponse
nodes.summary: StreamingResponse subclass that always listens for client disconnects and cancels the body task so stage cleanup runs.

nodes.name: sse_bytes
nodes.summary: Encodes a stream of chat chunks or StreamError items as SSE events, appending [DONE] only when the stream did not error.

nodes.name: to_http
nodes.summary: Converts a GatewayResponse into a JSON or SSE HTTP response carrying the request ID and anti-buffering headers.

nodes.name: build_providers
nodes.summary: Instantiates the configured OpenAI/Anthropic provider clients with their API keys from the environment.

nodes.name: create_app
nodes.summary: Builds the FastAPI app: constructs providers, breakers, store and stage chain, registers lifespan, error handler and all HTTP routes.

nodes.name: create_app_from_env
nodes.summary: Uvicorn factory entry point that loads Settings and config from the environment and calls create_app.

nodes.name: status_class
nodes.summary: Maps an HTTP status to a bounded label like 2xx, 5xx or 499.

nodes.name: Breaker
nodes.summary: Circuit breaker state machine tracking consecutive failures, open timeout and the half-open trial slot per provider.

nodes.name: retryable
nodes.summary: Decides whether a ProviderError (429, 5xx, connect/network/first-byte timeout) is worth retrying.

nodes.name: record
nodes.summary: Maps an upstream failure to the breaker update: release on 429, success on 4xx, failure otherwise.

nodes.name: to_gateway_error
nodes.summary: Translates a ProviderError into the client-facing GatewayError (timeout, bad request, upstream failed).

nodes.name: remaining
nodes.summary: Computes the remaining time budget capped at a per-attempt limit.

nodes.name: Attempts
nodes.summary: Runs the attempt loop for streaming and non-streaming calls, picking available targets via breakers, applying timeouts, backoff and fallback.

nodes.name: cache.py
nodes.summary: Pipeline stage providing an exact-match, per-key LRU cache with TTL for non-streaming temperature-0 chat requests, with bypass support via header.

nodes.name: observe.py
nodes.summary: Outermost pipeline stage that records Prometheus metrics, emits one structured JSON access log line and manages the request trace span, including deferred finalization for streamed responses.

nodes.name: streams.py
nodes.summary: Stream utilities for observing async chunk streams without buffering, guaranteeing exactly-once cleanup that survives cancellation via shielded background tasks.
nodes.languageNotes: Relies on asyncio.shield plus a module-level task set to keep cleanup coroutines alive and referenced during cancellation.

nodes.name: tracing.py
nodes.summary: Optional OpenTelemetry integration creating a request span and child provider-attempt spans; all functions are no-ops unless an OTLP endpoint is configured and the SDK is installed.
nodes.languageNotes: Lazy imports inside setup keep opentelemetry an optional extra.

nodes.name: cache_key
nodes.summary: Builds a SHA-256 cache key from key ID, alias and the canonical request payload minus stream/user fields.

nodes.name: Cache
nodes.summary: Stage implementing per-key TTL+LRU response caching with hit/miss/bypass metrics and fresh response IDs on hits.

nodes.name: Observe
nodes.summary: Outermost stage measuring in-flight, latency, TTFT and tokens, logging a JSON access line and ending the trace span, deferring finalization for streams.

nodes.name: StreamError
nodes.summary: Dataclass wrapping a GatewayError yielded once when a stream fails after the first byte.

nodes.name: shielded
nodes.summary: Runs a coroutine to completion despite caller cancellation by shielding a referenced background task.

nodes.name: drain_background
nodes.summary: Waits up to a timeout for pending shielded background tasks (e.g., usage writes) at shutdown.

nodes.name: wrap_stream
nodes.summary: Async generator that passes items through with optional per-item hook and invokes an on_close callback exactly once with the outcome (completed/error/cancelled).

nodes.name: setup
nodes.summary: Configures an OTLP HTTP exporter and global tracer when an endpoint is set and OpenTelemetry is installed.

nodes.name: start_request_span
nodes.summary: Starts the per-request chat.completions span or returns None when tracing is off.

nodes.name: start_attempt_span
nodes.summary: Starts a provider.attempt child span under the request span.

nodes.name: end
nodes.summary: Sets non-null attributes on a span and ends it; no-op for None.

nodes.name: conftest.py
nodes.summary: Shared pytest fixtures and helpers: builds test gateway configs, boots the gateway and a fake upstream on real sockets, and exposes a Gateway test handle for creating keys, sending chats and reading usage rows.

nodes.name: servers.py
nodes.summary: Runs ASGI apps on real localhost sockets via uvicorn inside the test event loop, so integration tests observe true streaming behavior instead of httpx ASGITransport buffering.

nodes.name: upstream.py
nodes.summary: Scriptable fake OpenAI + Anthropic upstream ASGI server; tests queue step scripts (chunks, waits, error statuses, usage, drops) and it records requests and client disconnects.

nodes.name: test_admin.py
nodes.summary: Integration tests for the admin API: admin-token auth, virtual keys denied on admin routes, model validation on key creation, hashed key storage, usage summaries and 404s.

nodes.name: test_chat.py
nodes.summary: End-to-end tests of non-streaming chat completions covering OpenAI/Anthropic translation, auth, revocation, model allow-lists, tool capability routing, rate limits, budgets, caching and metrics.

nodes.name: test_resilience.py
nodes.summary: End-to-end resilience tests for retries, fallback across providers, first-byte and idle timeouts, no retry after first byte, and circuit breaker open/fallback behavior.

nodes.name: test_shutdown.py
nodes.summary: Integration tests for health/readiness probes and the preStop drain sequence, including in-flight stream completion and loopback-only drain endpoint.

nodes.name: test_streaming.py
nodes.summary: Integration tests for SSE streaming: OpenAI passthrough, Anthropic-to-OpenAI translation, include_usage injection/stripping, unbuffered first chunk, and disconnect handling with estimated usage.

nodes.name: test_config.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for gateway config validation: valid config, missing pricing, unknown provider, drain vs total timeout, unknown keys rejected, and the example K8s config loading with required API keys.

nodes.name: config_dict
nodes.summary: Returns a baseline gateway config dict with openai/anthropic providers, fast/gpt/claude aliases, pricing, timeouts, retries and shutdown settings pointed at a given upstream URL.

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Recursively deep-merges override dicts into a base config dict.

nodes.name: make_config
nodes.summary: Builds a validated Config from the baseline dict with keyword overrides deep-merged in.

nodes.name: Gateway
nodes.summary: Test handle wrapping a running gateway: URL, deps, httpx client and server, with helpers to create virtual keys, send chat requests and poll usage rows from the store.

nodes.name: sse_events
nodes.summary: Parses SSE lines into data payloads, decoding JSON events and keeping the [DONE] sentinel as a string.

nodes.name: upstream
nodes.summary: Pytest fixture starting a FakeUpstream on a real socket and stopping it after the test.

nodes.name: start_gateway
nodes.summary: Pytest fixture factory that starts gateway instances with config overrides, an isolated SQLite DB per instance, and cleans up clients and servers afterward.

nodes.name: gateway
nodes.summary: Pytest fixture providing a default-configured running gateway.

nodes.name: RunningServer
nodes.summary: Holds a running uvicorn server, its serving task and URL, with a stop() that signals exit and awaits the task.

nodes.name: start_server
nodes.summary: Binds an ephemeral localhost socket, starts uvicorn with lifespan in a background task, waits until started (surfacing startup errors) and returns a RunningServer.

nodes.name: chunks
nodes.summary: Script step: emit n content chunks with an optional delay between them.

nodes.name: wait
nodes.summary: Script step: stall for s seconds to simulate first-byte or idle delays.

nodes.name: status
nodes.summary: Script step: respond with an HTTP error code and optional retry-after.

nodes.name: usage
nodes.summary: Script step: report input/output token usage at the end of a response.

nodes.name: drop
nodes.summary: Script step: drop the connection mid-stream.

nodes.name: FakeUpstream
nodes.summary: ASGI app emulating OpenAI chat completions and Anthropic messages APIs in both JSON and SSE modes, executing per-request scripted steps and recording requests and disconnects.

nodes.name: test_usage_summary
nodes.summary: Verifies the admin usage endpoint aggregates request counts, tokens and per-alias breakdowns for a key.

nodes.name: test_non_streaming_openai
nodes.summary: Checks a non-streaming OpenAI call returns alias model, request id, no stream_options upstream, and a correctly costed usage row.

nodes.name: test_non_streaming_anthropic
nodes.summary: Checks OpenAI-to-Anthropic request translation (system, stop_sequences, temperature clamp, max_tokens) and usage mapping.

nodes.name: test_auth_errors
nodes.summary: Verifies invalid or missing keys get 401 authentication errors with no upstream call and no usage row.

nodes.name: test_cache_hit_and_bypass
nodes.summary: Verifies temperature-0 responses are cached (miss then hit with new id), bypass header skips cache, and usage rows mark cache hits at zero cost.

nodes.name: stream_events
nodes.summary: Helper that sends a streaming chat request and returns the status code plus parsed SSE events or the error body.

nodes.name: test_breaker_opens_and_returns_503
nodes.summary: Verifies consecutive failures open the circuit breaker so later requests get 503 with retry-after and no upstream call.

nodes.name: test_open_breaker_falls_back
nodes.summary: Verifies an open breaker on OpenAI causes the fast alias to fall back to Anthropic.

nodes.name: test_drain_flips_readyz
nodes.summary: Verifies POST /internal/drain flips readiness to 503 and refuses new requests while an in-flight stream completes.

nodes.name: test_drain_is_loopback_only
nodes.summary: Invokes the ASGI app with a fake remote client address to verify the drain endpoint returns 404 for non-loopback callers.

nodes.name: stream_lines
nodes.summary: Helper that sends a streaming chat request, asserts an SSE 200 response, and returns all raw lines.

nodes.name: test_anthropic_stream_is_translated
nodes.summary: Verifies Anthropic SSE events are translated to OpenAI chunk format with correct content, finish reason, auth header and recorded usage.

nodes.name: test_first_chunk_before_upstream_finishes
nodes.summary: Verifies the gateway forwards the first chunk without buffering the whole upstream stream.

nodes.name: test_disconnect_closes_upstream
nodes.summary: Verifies a client disconnect propagates and closes the upstream connection.

nodes.name: test_disconnect_writes_estimated_usage
nodes.summary: Verifies a mid-stream client disconnect records a 499 usage row with estimated output tokens and nonzero cost.

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: Defines the gateway's validated configuration: environment-backed Settings for secrets and frozen Pydantic models for providers, model aliases, pricing, stages, timeouts, retries, breaker and shutdown, loaded from a single YAML file at startup.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses pydantic-settings BaseSettings for env vars and a frozen, extra='forbid' base model so config typos fail fast; a model_validator(mode='after') performs cross-field checks.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.summary: Environment-driven settings (config path, DB path, admin token, OTLP endpoint, log level) loaded via pydantic-settings.

nodes.name: ProviderCfg
nodes.summary: Per-provider settings: base URL, API key env var name, and default max_tokens used by the Anthropic adapter.

nodes.name: TargetCfg
nodes.summary: A routing target pairing a provider name with an upstream model id.

nodes.name: ModelCfg
nodes.summary: Model alias definition holding an ordered, non-empty list of fallback targets.

nodes.name: Price
nodes.summary: Per-model token pricing in USD per million input and output tokens.

nodes.name: Toggle
nodes.summary: Simple enabled/disabled switch for an optional pipeline stage.

nodes.name: CacheCfg
nodes.summary: Response cache settings: enabled flag, max entries and TTL.

nodes.name: StagesCfg
nodes.summary: Groups per-stage settings for the cache and budget stages.

nodes.name: Timeouts
nodes.summary: Upstream timeout knobs: connect, first-byte, idle and total request durations.

nodes.name: Retries
nodes.summary: Retry policy: maximum attempts and exponential backoff base.

nodes.name: BreakerCfg
nodes.summary: Circuit breaker settings: failure threshold and open duration.

nodes.name: ShutdownCfg
nodes.summary: Graceful shutdown settings: drain duration and drain-endpoint delay.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.summary: Root gateway configuration whose cross_checks validator enforces alias format, known providers, pricing for every target model, and consistent timeout/drain relationships.

nodes.name: ConfigError
nodes.summary: ValueError raised when configuration is invalid at load time, e.g. a missing provider API key.

nodes.name: load_config
nodes.summary: Reads the YAML config file, validates it into a Config, and verifies every provider's API key environment variable is set.

nodes.name: base.py
nodes.summary: Defines the Provider protocol every adapter implements and shared HTTP helpers that build httpx clients and classify transport, HTTP and JSON failures into ProviderError.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses typing.Protocol for structural typing of adapters and a Literal alias to constrain error kinds.

nodes.name: ProviderError
nodes.summary: Exception carrying a classified failure kind (connect, network, timeouts, http, protocol) plus optional status, retry-after and message.

nodes.name: Provider
nodes.summary: Protocol describing a provider adapter: name, tool support flag, complete, stream and aclose.

nodes.name: make_client
nodes.summary: Builds an httpx.AsyncClient with base URL, headers and a connect timeout, leaving read timeouts to the route stage.

nodes.name: transport_error
nodes.summary: Maps an httpx transport exception to a 'connect' or 'network' ProviderError.

nodes.name: http_error
nodes.summary: Reads an error HTTP response and builds an 'http' ProviderError with status, parsed error message and Retry-After.

nodes.name: parse_retry_after
nodes.summary: Parses a numeric Retry-After header into seconds, ignoring HTTP-date forms.

nodes.name: parse_json
nodes.summary: Parses provider JSON text into a dict, raising a 'protocol' ProviderError on invalid or non-object payloads.

nodes.name: openai.py
nodes.summary: OpenAI provider adapter that is a near passthrough of the internal OpenAI-shaped format, normalizing max_tokens and stream usage options and parsing SSE chunks.

nodes.name: OpenAIProvider
nodes.summary: OpenAI adapter implementing complete and stream against /chat/completions, rewriting max_tokens to max_completion_tokens, forcing include_usage on streams, and raising protocol errors on bad shapes or missing [DONE].

nodes.name: anthropic.py
nodes.summary: Anthropic provider adapter translating OpenAI-shaped chat requests to the Messages API (system prompt, max_tokens, stop sequences) and translating responses and SSE stream events back into OpenAI-style chunks; tools are unsupported.

nodes.name: _content
nodes.summary: Normalizes message content to a string or list of text blocks, rejecting non-text parts with BadRequest.

nodes.name: to_anthropic
nodes.summary: Translates a ChatRequest into an Anthropic Messages API body, hoisting system/developer messages, rejecting tool calls and mapping max_tokens and stop.

nodes.name: from_anthropic
nodes.summary: Converts an Anthropic Messages response into an OpenAI-shaped ChatResponse with mapped finish reasons and usage.

nodes.name: AnthropicProvider
nodes.summary: Anthropic adapter whose complete and stream methods call /v1/messages, mapping message_start/content_block_delta/message_delta/message_stop events into chunks and error events (overloaded as 529) into ProviderError.

nodes.name: schemas.py
nodes.summary: OpenAI-shaped Pydantic request, response and stream chunk models that allow extra fields so unknown parameters pass through the gateway.

nodes.name: ChatRequest
nodes.summary: Validated chat completion request with messages, streaming, sampling, token limit, stop and tools fields, plus payload() for dumping non-null fields.

nodes.name: ChatResponse
nodes.summary: Non-streaming chat completion response model with choices and optional usage.

nodes.name: ChatChunk
nodes.summary: Streaming chat.completion.chunk model with choices and optional usage.

nodes.name: sse.py
nodes.summary: Server-sent events helpers that parse upstream provider SSE line streams into events and encode JSON objects into SSE frames for clients.

nodes.name: SSEEvent
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding an SSE event name and joined data payload.

nodes.name: parse_sse
nodes.summary: Async generator turning text lines into SSEEvents, handling multi-line data, event names, comments/keep-alives and blank-line terminators.

nodes.name: encode_event
nodes.summary: Encodes a dict as a compact JSON 'data:' SSE frame.

nodes.name: route.py
nodes.summary: Terminal pipeline stage that filters capable targets, invokes providers through retry/fallback attempts, and relays streams with idle/total deadlines, usage accounting and circuit-breaker bookkeeping.
nodes.languageNotes: Async generator relay uses asyncio.timeout around anext() and a shielded finally-block cleanup so breaker accounting survives client cancellation.

nodes.name: content_chars
nodes.summary: Counts content characters in a streamed chunk's deltas for output token estimation.

nodes.name: usage_of
nodes.summary: Converts a raw usage dict into a Usage record of prompt and completion tokens.

nodes.name: Route
nodes.summary: Route stage: selects tool-capable targets, runs non-streaming or streaming attempts, rewrites model to the alias, and relays stream chunks while recording breaker success, failure or release.

nodes.name: test_adapters.py
nodes.summary: Pytest suite exercising the OpenAI and Anthropic adapters against recorded provider responses replayed with respx, covering streaming translation, payload rewriting, error classification and request/response translation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses respx to mock httpx transports with recorded SSE byte streams.

nodes.name: test_openai_stream_parses_and_injects_usage
nodes.summary: Verifies the OpenAI stream is parsed into chunks including the injected usage chunk and include_usage option.

nodes.name: test_openai_payload_sends_max_completion_tokens
nodes.summary: Checks max_tokens is rewritten to max_completion_tokens in the OpenAI payload.

nodes.name: test_openai_truncated_stream_is_protocol_error
nodes.summary: Ensures an OpenAI stream ending without [DONE] raises a protocol ProviderError.

nodes.name: test_openai_http_error_carries_status_and_retry_after
nodes.summary: Asserts HTTP errors from OpenAI carry status and parsed Retry-After.

nodes.name: test_connect_error_is_classified
nodes.summary: Checks that connection failures are classified as 'connect' ProviderErrors.

nodes.name: test_anthropic_stream_translation
nodes.summary: Verifies Anthropic SSE events are translated into OpenAI-style chunks with finish reason and usage.

nodes.name: test_anthropic_error_event_is_529_when_overloaded
nodes.summary: Asserts an Anthropic overloaded error event becomes a ProviderError with status 529.

nodes.name: test_to_anthropic_request_translation
nodes.summary: Checks to_anthropic hoists system prompts and maps max_tokens, stop and other fields.

nodes.name: test_to_anthropic_defaults_and_refusals
nodes.summary: Checks default max_tokens and BadRequest refusals for tool calls or unsupported content.

nodes.name: test_from_anthropic_response
nodes.summary: Verifies from_anthropic converts a Messages response into an OpenAI-shaped ChatResponse.

nodes.name: memory.py
nodes.summary: In-process token-bucket rate limiter giving each virtual key up to rpm requests, refilled continuously at rpm/60 tokens per second; lock-free because acquire() never awaits.
nodes.languageNotes: An async method with no await points runs atomically under asyncio's single-threaded event loop, so no lock is needed.

nodes.name: MemoryLimiter
nodes.summary: Token-bucket limiter storing (tokens, updated_at) per key with an injectable clock; acquire() returns (allowed, retry_after_seconds).

nodes.name: clock.py
nodes.summary: Test fake providing a manually advanced monotonic clock so time-dependent limiter and breaker tests run instantly.

nodes.name: FakeClock
nodes.summary: Controllable clock exposing now() and advance(seconds), injected in place of time.monotonic in tests.

nodes.name: test_basics.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for core building blocks: SSE parsing, the wrap_stream close-ordering and cancellation semantics, cost/token estimation, the in-memory token bucket, and circuit breaker state transitions.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses pytest async tests with async generators and asyncio cancellation to verify cleanup ordering.

nodes.name: lines
nodes.summary: Async generator helper yielding the given strings as a fake line stream for SSE parsing.

nodes.name: test_parse_sse_events_and_comments
nodes.summary: Verifies parse_sse ignores comments, handles named events, joins multi-line data, and flushes a trailing event.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README, which presents llm-gateway as a small, learning-oriented OpenAI-compatible gateway: clients use any OpenAI SDK, and the gateway routes requests to OpenAI or Anthropic while adding virtual keys, usage and cost tracking, rate limits, budgets, resilience, metrics and caching. It also shows how to run the gateway locally with uvicorn, how to test it and how to deploy it to Kubernetes. Use it as the map for the rest of the tour.

tour.title: Spec and Design Docs
tour.description: Before reading code, skim the design trilogy. SPEC.md defines the contracts and the phased features, HLD.md explains the seven-stage request pipeline and the request lifecycle around the first byte, and LLD.md details the core types, the stream wrapper, each stage and the provider adapters. Each code step that follows implements something these documents describe.

tour.title: The Application Factory
tour.description: gateway/app.py is the entry point and the file with the most outgoing dependencies. Its factory, create_app_from_env, wires together the providers, the per-provider circuit breakers, the SQLite store and the ordered stage pipeline, and it mounts the admin router. Nearly every module you will meet later is imported directly from here, so this file shows the whole runtime layout in one place.
tour.languageLesson: The app factory pattern (a function that builds and returns the FastAPI app, run with `uvicorn --factory`) makes configuration explicit and lets tests build isolated app instances with different settings instead of sharing a single global app object.

tour.title: Configuration and Model Aliases
tour.description: config.py is the most depended-upon module in the codebase. It combines environment-backed Settings for secrets with frozen Pydantic models for providers, model aliases, fallback targets, pricing and timeouts. The ConfigMap file deploy/k8s/base/config.yaml is a real instance of this schema: it defines the client-facing aliases such as `fast` and `smart`, and the process refuses to start if a referenced provider key is missing.
tour.languageLesson: Pydantic models with `frozen=True` and `extra='forbid'` turn a YAML file into validated, immutable Python objects, so typos and invalid values fail fast at startup instead of surfacing mid-request.

tour.title: Core Domain Vocabulary
tour.description: Three heavily shared modules define the vocabulary that the pipeline uses. context.py holds the per-request RequestContext that every stage reads and writes, along with Target, Usage and GatewayResponse. schemas.py defines OpenAI-shaped request and response models that let unknown fields pass through. errors.py renders a GatewayError hierarchy in OpenAI's error format, including Retry-After headers where they apply, so existing SDKs behave correctly.
tour.languageLesson: Python dataclasses give a lightweight, mutable per-request state object, while Pydantic models validate untrusted input at the edge. This codebase uses each one where it fits best.

tour.title: The Stage Pipeline Pattern
tour.description: stages/base.py defines the Stage protocol and build_chain, which composes stages into nested middleware around a terminal handler. Every request flows through the same chain: Observe, Auth, Usage, RateLimit, Budget, Cache and then Route. The stage test suite exercises each stage in isolation with a fake call_next, which is the clearest way to see the pattern in action.
tour.languageLesson: `typing.Protocol` enables structural typing: any class with a matching `__call__(ctx, call_next)` signature counts as a Stage, with no inheritance required. This is Python's take on Go-style interfaces.

tour.title: Virtual Keys and Persistence
tour.description: The Auth stage hashes the bearer key and looks it up through the Store protocol, which aiosqlite implements on top of two tables: api_keys holds hashed virtual keys with model allowlists, RPM limits and budgets, and usage is a per-request ledger linked to those keys. Plaintext gw- keys are never stored, only their SHA-256 hashes. The Phase 1 notes explain the 401 versus 403 semantics.
tour.languageLesson: SQL foreign keys (usage referencing api_keys) keep the ledger consistent with the keys it bills. A unique request_id makes usage writes idempotent, so a retried write cannot double-count.

tour.title: Usage, Cost and Budgets
tour.description: Building on the store, the Usage stage writes exactly one usage row per authenticated request once the response or stream finishes. pricing.py turns token counts into USD and estimates tokens with a rough characters-per-token rule when a stream is cut short. The Budget stage then reads monthly spend back from the store to enforce a soft cap per key.

tour.title: Rate Limiting
tour.description: The RateLimit stage depends on the Limiter protocol rather than a concrete class. The in-memory implementation is a per-key token bucket that refills continuously at rpm/60 tokens per second, and an empty bucket returns a 429 response with Retry-After. Keeping the limiter behind a protocol leaves room for the Redis limiter planned for the K2 scale-out.

tour.title: Provider Adapters and SSE
tour.description: Route, the terminal stage, calls upstream providers through the Provider protocol. The OpenAI adapter is close to a passthrough. The Anthropic adapter translates OpenAI-shaped requests to the Messages API and translates the responses and streams back. sse.py parses upstream server-sent events and encodes OpenAI-style frames for the client, and the Phase 0 notes explain how streaming relays chunks one at a time.
tour.languageLesson: Async generators (`async def` combined with `yield`) let the gateway relay a stream chunk by chunk without buffering it, which keeps time-to-first-token low.

tour.title: Routing and Resilience
tour.description: route.py selects targets that can handle the request and calls them through retry.py's attempt loop, which applies first-byte timeouts, jittered exponential backoff and fallback by rotating to another target, but only before the first byte reaches the client. breaker.py adds a per-provider circuit breaker with closed, open and half-open states. streams.py guarantees exactly-once cleanup even when a client disconnects mid-stream.
tour.languageLesson: `asyncio.shield` protects cleanup work, such as recording usage, from being cancelled when the surrounding request task is cancelled because of a client disconnect.

tour.title: Observability and Caching
tour.description: Observe is the outermost stage: it records the Prometheus metrics defined in metrics.py, writes one JSON access log line per request and manages the optional OpenTelemetry span from tracing.py. The Cache stage, which sits just before Route, serves exact-match responses from a per-key LRU with a TTL, but only for non-streaming requests with temperature 0. The Prometheus alerts in deploy/observability build on these metrics.

tour.title: Testing with Fake Upstreams
tour.description: The integration tests start the real gateway and a scriptable fake OpenAI and Anthropic upstream on real localhost sockets, so they need no provider keys or network access. conftest.py wires the fixtures together, and test_resilience.py drives retries, fallback, timeouts and the circuit breaker end to end, covering the resilience behavior from Step 11.
tour.languageLesson: pytest fixtures declared in conftest.py are discovered automatically and injected by parameter name, which lets many test files share the same server setup.

tour.title: Container and CI
tour.description: The Dockerfile uses a multi-stage build: a build stage syncs frozen dependencies with uv into a virtualenv, and a slim Python 3.13 runtime stage copies only the venv and the gateway source, then runs as an unprivileged user. The GitHub Actions workflow runs lint, formatting checks and tests on every push and pull request, alongside a Docker image build.
tour.languageLesson: Multi-stage Docker builds keep build tools out of the final image. Copying the lock file and installing dependencies before copying the source lets Docker reuse the cached dependency layer when only code changes.

tour.title: Kubernetes and EKS Deployment
tour.description: The Kustomize base assembles the Deployment (with readiness and liveness probes and a preStop drain hook), the Service, a NetworkPolicy and an Ingress that exposes only /v1. The k1 overlay adds a PVC for the SQLite database and uses the Recreate strategy for a single replica, and the eks overlay adapts it for an ECR image and an HTTPS ALB. The Terraform in infra/eks provisions the VPC, the EKS Auto Mode cluster and the ECR repository.
tour.languageLesson: Kustomize overlays patch a shared base instead of copying it: k1 and eks each layer only their differences, such as the storage, rollout strategy, image and ingress, on top of the same manifests.
